proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 5160 article records Ta. yāṉ, nāṉ ( obl. eṉ- ) I; yāṉmai egoism; eṉavaṉ one who is mine; eṉava mine (neut. pl. ). Ma. ñān ( obl. en- ) I. Ko. a·n ( obl. en-; e- with some relationship terms). To. o·n ( obl. en- ).…. The G1 form continues this article's I sense.
